_doc: Generated doctrine-lattice projection from governed JSON instances where present, legacy routing source where parity is still required, and computed support-cover output.
anti_claim: This projection cannot upgrade source authority, certify strong support, authorize release, or count unresolved residual pressure as complete.

anti_principle_instance_corpus.anti_claim: Anti-principle JSON presence is migration progress, not proof that every failed-principle relation is obligation-mapped.

axiom_instance_corpus.anti_claim: Axiom JSON presence is migration progress, not proof that every axiom is witnessed or that source authority has flipped from the routing registry.

concept_instance_corpus.anti_claim: Concept JSON presence is migration progress, not proof that every concept is principle-grounded, axiom-constrained, or mechanism-instantiated.

coverage_health.anti_claim: Health rows route gaps to residual pressure; they do not weaken doctrine or upgrade coverage.

anti_principles.support_scope: anti-principle guard edges resolve violated axioms; failed-principle negation binding remains residual until obligation-level mapping exists

code_loci.support_scope: derived from source relationship edges; path existence is not code correctness, runtime proof, or release authority

concepts.support_scope: concept specimen parity and typed selective neighbours are computed from source-named ids; unresolved or omitted selective edges remain residual pressure

doctrine_kinds.support_scope: derived from standard.governs and skill.acts_on edges; kind handles are walkability nodes, not complete ontology, runtime use, or release authority

capsule_dependency_upstream_parity.relation_direction: paper_module A depends_on paper_module B maps to mechanism(B).upstream_of mechanism(A); the reverse direction is not inferred from depends_on.

mechanisms.support_scope: mechanism selective residuals are typed from source rows plus the relation registry; capsule depends_on evidence classifies upstream residual fillability and confirms dependency mechanisms as upstream_of their consumers, but is not a reverse-edge fill or runtime truth claim.

The organ wrapper `microcosm_core.organs.derived_fact_provider_runtime` adds the standard organ contract over that capsule without re-implementing it: it loads bounded JSON fixture cases, calls the capsule's real evaluate_case on each, and classifies positives (must resolve to expected values with an ok receipt) versus negatives (must be rejected by recomputation with the exact expected error_class firing on the planted-defect fact, mapped in EXPECTED_NEGATIVE_CASES). It projects a body-free result_card and writes body-free result/board/validation/acceptance receipts via microcosm_core.receipts, and exposes run / bundle / CLI dispatch mirroring the bridge_campaign_dag_validation template exactly.

The engine-room capsule `microcosm_core.engine_room.derived_fact_provider_engine` is the executable authority: a source-faithful public refactor of system/lib/derived_fact_hologram.py + codex/doctrine/facts/fact_registry.json. It evaluates an authored fact registry against a public-safe root, resolving each row through one of three providers — json_pointer (RFC 6901, including list-index traversal), glob_count (file-count matching with optional excluded prefixes), and named callable facts (git-tracked file/python counts via a git subprocess in a tempdir) — and turns any provider failure into an error-as-data row (provider_status=error, error_class, repair hint) that degrades the receipt status from ok to degraded rather than crashing the ledger.

Surfaces the egress_self_compliance_gate capsule as a first-class agent-reliability organ. Adds the standard organ contract over the capsule's evaluate_text entrypoint: loads bounded JSON fixture cases, classifies positive vs negative by case_type/expected_ok, recomputes each verdict via the live capsule, asserts planted negatives are flagged red with the exact expected violating diagnostic_id (EXPECTED_NEGATIVE_CASES), aggregates a pass/fail status, projects a body-free result_card, and writes body-free result/board/validation (and optional acceptance) receipts via microcosm_core.receipts. Pass requires both positives clean (green), both negatives rejected with their expected marker, and the expected negative case_ids present.

Phrase-membership egress self-compliance policy over one agent-output text string. Runs three detectors that each fire only when a tripwire phrase is present AND its matching legitimiser phrase is absent: permission-gate-without-blocker, self-error-without-capture, command-displacement-to-operator. Returns green when no detector reports a violation, red otherwise. The capsule is the authority for the detection logic and phrase tables; it is a source-faithful public refactor of system/lib/egress_compliance.py.

Surfaces the engine-room capsule as a first-class organ with the standard contract (bounded fixture cases, planted negatives, body-free receipts, result_card, CLI). _evaluate_case materialises each fixture's declared file tree into a per-case TemporaryDirectory scratch and calls the REAL capsule evaluate_case (no re-implementation, no baked answers); build_result returns status==pass only when both positives observe clean, both negatives are recomputed to drift carrying their expected status_reason marker, and the expected negative case ids are present.

Public-safe owner-routed generated-projection drift gate. Models each generated artifact as an owner row (artifact patterns, source authorities, a no-write check command); per owner it SHA-256-fingerprints source and artifact files, consults a prior-clean-receipt source-hash skip cache, enforces required-artifact presence and optional fact-authority lineage, then runs the owner's declared no-write check command and marks the owner clean only on a zero return with present artifacts. It is the drift authority, not a semantic content-diff proof, a repairer, or a release authority.
